subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a supported config knob for workspace bootstrap context selection?
rationale: The implementation is focused and currently source-consistent, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and this choice changes session context semantics for users who opt in.

options.title: Accept the core config knob
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review of this PR as the focused additive tier contract, requiring unchanged no-override defaults plus docs and exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap policy
options.body: Pause this PR behind a broader context-selection design that covers tiering, per-session filtering, hook extras, and prompt-budget work together.

options.title: Decline the new config surface
options.body: Close or replace the PR and steer users to existing context controls such as `contextInjection`, bootstrap budgets, lightweight mode, or a future owner-designed API.

recommendation.title: Accept the core config knob
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review of this PR as the focused additive tier contract, requiring unchanged no-override defaults plus docs and exact-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and recent agent bootstrap/config history make this the best available product/API decision owner.
